querystring.select: SELECT B.DESCR AS VendorCategory,A.IS_ACTIVE AS AciveStatus,A.VENDOR_CODE As HoldingCode,A.TAX_ID_NO AS TaxNumber,A.VENDOR_NAME AS HoldingName,A.VENDOR_ID AS VendorId,C.DESCR AS HoldingType, A.MR_VENDOR_CLASS AS VendorClass
querystring.from: FROM dbo.VENDOR A WITH(NOLOCK)LEFT JOIN dbo.REF_MASTER B WITH(NOLOCK) ON  A.MR_VENDOR_CATEGORY_CODE = B.MASTER_CODE LEFT JOIN dbo.REF_MASTER C WITH (NOLOCK) ON a.MR_VENDOR_TYPE_CODE = C.MASTER_CODE AND C.REF_MASTER_TYPE_CODE = 'VENDOR_TYPE'
